neighbours.label: a blog comment thanking the host or sponsor of a challenge, contest or giveaway, as opposed to comments about the same event without thanks
fire: What a fun theme! Thank you so much for running this challenge. I loved making my card.
Lovely prizes this month. Many thanks for hosting the giveaway, I would love to win the yarn.
I read twelve books this year. Thanks for organizing this reading challenge!
My first entry ever. Thank you for sponsoring this contest! It was a lot of fun.
Great blog. Thanks for the chance to win, I would really love the cookbook.
So many talented people here. Thank you for putting this blog hop together!
Fingers crossed! Thanks so much for the giveaway and good luck everyone.
I shared my new quilt. Thank you for hosting this week's link party!
